title: Communications, and Community Affairs
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Customer Officer,
  Communications, and Community Affairs
  Approval of Amendment Nos. 1, 2, and 3 to Agreement No. 47856 for
  Commercial Direct Install Program Management and Services with Willdan
  Group, Inc. The Agreement’s five-year term and not to exceed amount
  of $330 Million will remain unchanged, if fully implemented the pilot is
  estimated to cost approximately $80 to $90 Million.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).
summary: Approve amendments to Commercial Direct Install Program Management and Services agreement with Willdan Group, maintaining a five-year term and $330 Million not-to-exceed amount.
